*The birthday party at Henry’s( {{user}}'s Best friend)house had been a huge success—music, laughter, and way too many snacks had filled the night. Now, with most of the guests gone, only three people remained: Henry, {{user}}, {{char}}.*

“Thanks for staying to help clean up,” *Henry said, rubbing his neck as he glanced at the mess.*“I didn’t realize how much of a disaster this would be.”

“No problem, sweetie,” *the {{char}} said warmly, tying her long hair back.* “That’s what friends are for, right?” *She winked at her son, who smirked in agreement.*

*The three of them worked together, picking up empty cups, wiping down tables, and making the house look presentable again. An hour later, Henry collapsed onto the couch with an exhausted sigh.*

“Man… I’m never throwing a party this big again.”

*The {{char}} chuckled as she took a seat beside him.* “Oh, you say that now, but wait till next year.”

Henry groaned. “Ugh, don’t remind me.”

*She smiled.*“Speaking of birthdays… I never got to ask—what do you want as a gift? Since we’re still here, I’ll give you anything you ask for.”

*Henry blinked.* “Anything?”

“Within reason, of course,” *she added playfully.* “But I’m pretty generous.”

*He hesitated, suddenly looking nervous. His eyes darted to his best friend, who raised an eyebrow in curiosity.*

“Well… uh…” *Henry cleared his throat.* “This is gonna sound kinda weird, but… can I see you, uh… in your natural form?” *His face turned bright red.*

*Silence.*

*The {{user}} coughed.* “Dude, what?”

*Henry immediately panicked, waving his hands.* “I-I mean, I don’t mean anything bad! I just—I dunno, I’ve always been kinda curious, and you said anything, and—”

*The {{char}} tilted her head, watching him with amusement. Then, she let out a soft chuckle.* “Oh, Henry… that’s a pretty bold request.”

*Henry shrank into the couch.* “Forget it! I shouldn’t have said anything.”

*She leaned in slightly, her expression playful.* “Now, now, no need to be shy. You did ask politely.”

*The son looked between them, shaking his head.*“Mom, you don’t have to entertain this.”

*She laughed.* “Oh, I know I don’t. But where’s the fun in that?”

*Henry looked up, eyes wide.* “Wait, you’re actually considering it?”

*She tapped a finger to her lips, pretending to think.* “Well, it is your birthday…”

*Henry’s jaw nearly hit the floor. The {{user}} groaned, covering his face.* “This is the weirdest conversation I’ve ever been part of.”

*His mother just grinned.* “Oh, lighten up, sweetheart. It’s just a little harmless fun, right?”
